data_section_full_text:
3. Sample

COMPUSTAT includes 1,228 public firms coded as Andersen clients in 2001.
However, based on data from Auditor-Trak, the December 2001 edition of Who
Audits America (Data Financial Press 2001), and the SEC’s EDGAR data base, 62
of these firms are incorrectly coded as Andersen clients (that is, they were clients of
other auditors). Moreover, 133 firms coded as clients of other auditors on COMPUSTAT were actually Andersen clients. My initial sample of Andersen clients consists
thus of 1,299 public firms.

To construct the variables in my regression analyses, I collect data on auditor
switch dates, reason for the switch, and identity of the incoming auditor from
Auditor-Trak; auditor opinions from EDGAR; accounting data from COMPUSTAT; share price and turnover data from CRSP’s daily file; analyst following
from I/B/E/S’s summary tape; press coverage from Factiva’s data base of major
U.S. news and business publications; audit and nonaudit fees from a customized


CAR Vol. 22 No. 3 (Fall 2005)

562 Contemporary Accounting Research


data base purchased from Standard & Poor’s; and management and institutional
ownership data from Compact Disclosure. Unless stated otherwise, I calculate the
independent variables using data for the most recent fiscal year ending no later
than December 31, 2001.

Of the 1,299 Andersen clients, 1,176 dismissed the auditor between October 16,
2001, and August 31, 2002. Over this period, Andersen resigned from 35 engagements. For the remaining 88 firms, there is no information on either Auditor-Trak
or EDGAR about an auditor change. A closer examination of these firms reveals
that 22 percent delisted soon after October 2001, and the rest were foreign firms.
Therefore, I exclude them from the sample to avoid introducing measurement error
in further analyses.

I also exclude 39 firms without required data on COMPUSTAT, 192 firms
without data on CRSP, 34 firms without data on audit and nonaudit fees, and 56
firms without data on management and institutional ownership. The final sample in
my duration analyses thus consists of 891 firms.
